title: Fleet snapshot manifest
description: One stable fleet snapshot: exactly one packaged Release asset per utility, pinned by repo, tag, asset name and SHA256. Verify-FleetSnapshot.ps1 reads this file for its patterns and limits, so the schema and the script cannot drift. Unknown fields are refused: a field added later raises the version in `schema`.

snapshot.description: Name of this snapshot, for example 2026.11.0.

channel.description: Only the stable (pinned) channel has a manifest. The per-utility latest (beta) channel is verified against the Release's own published checksum and is not described here.

created.description: When the snapshot was cut, UTC, to the second.

id.description: The tool's id in catalog.json. Unique in the manifest.

repo.description: owner/name on GitHub. Unique in the manifest.

tag.description: The Release tag, for example v0.4.0.

asset.description: File name of the zip, no folder part, for example SnapShackle-v0.4.0.zip (CONVENTIONS.md, Releases). Unique in the manifest.

sha256.description: SHA256 of the zip, 64 hex digits. Compared without regard to case.

bytes.description: Optional exact size of the zip in bytes. When present it must match.
